content.short: Nexus Mutual offers a decentralized alternative to insurance for Ethereum users.
content.description: Founded in 2017, Nexus Mutual provides an alternative to traditional insurance for Ethereum users. It operates as a discretionary mutual, enabling members to buy coverage against material losses when transferring funds into a protocol’s smart contracts or when funds are held with a custodian. Members hold NXM tokens that represent proportional ownership of the mutual and participate in governance, capital provision, and the assessment of risk and claims.
